purposes.command.document.object.component.expose: Expose a property of a component.
Edit the state of a component.

resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; no document or resource payload. Requests above 4096 encoded bytes are refused, never split.

semantics: Convert one layer into a component in place or merge several layers into one new component instance, place an existing component as a new locked instance layer, expose a component property bound to one inner stroke, and edit the playback of a placed instance from the Component Instance panel (instance.set: any of mode loop|once|pingpong|single, singleFrame, placedAt, speed above zero and, with singleFrame, atFrame, the outer frame the playhead is on: an outer keyframe there also takes the pick as its component frame and loses its blank flag; only the named members change, a value equal to the stored one publishes nothing, a layer that is not a scene component instance is not_found), as sealed transactions through the single native owner. Targets are stable native layerUid and component symbolId values; the exposed-property key is made by the caller (ep_ plus the base-36 clock and four random base-36 digits, as the baseline expose()). One revision and one undo entry per applied edit; a no-op (the same exposed property twice) publishes nothing. A request made inside an open component, a v1 document, or a layer kind the baseline refuses is a typed refusal that publishes nothing. Animating a flat layer never converts it; only these requests do. state.edit writes what a declared component owns, its own camera keys (sym.cameraKeys: setCameraKey upserts the key at an inner frame, a new key taking the baseline defaults of rotation 0, zero handles and the ease-in-out curve, removeCameraKey, setCameraEase, clearCamera) and its markers (sym.markers: one per frame, addMarker, updateMarker, removeMarker, clearMarkers) by naming the component as contextId; the scene root is unavailable here (its camera and markers have their own owners), an unknown component or an absent key or marker is not_found, a frame past the component or a malformed value is invalid_request, and an edit that changes nothing publishes nothing. breakApart is the inverse of convert (the baseline convertComponentToLayer): it evaluates the instance of a scene-root layer on every frame through the one component join (held outer keys, playback mode, speed and placement, exposed overrides, the component's own camera keys, then the instance matrix), bakes what it shows into ordinary authored-frame records of that layer, collapses identical consecutive frames into one key plus holds, keeps a blank as a key, removes the instance record and unlocks the layer in one revision and one undo entry; the component stays in the table for any other instance, and the layer keeps its own Motion, range and duplicator. A layer that is not an instance is not_found, a context other than the scene root is unavailable, and a component holding text blocks, brush images or image meshes, Motion on its inner layers other than the layer opacity, or two inner layers sharing a stroke id is a typed unavailable refusal (stable code component-break-apart) that publishes nothing. Images are baked at the rect the instance painted (centre mapped by the component camera then the instance matrix, size scaled by its column scales, rotation dropped), the Time Remap of the instance names the inner frame as the viewport does, the opacity track of an inner layer is folded into the baked opacity, and inner groups and rigs are not content of the baked frames (the baseline flattens the strokes only). No JS/Paper writer or optimistic mutation.
